page.overview:
Who is Gina Panchella?

Gina Panchella (a.k.a. Sandwich Woman) is a character in (2018).

On Halloween night, Gina is looking after the baby of a woman named Kate and waiting for her husband, Ralph, to finish his swing shift. She goes out to her backyard shed to collect a frozen chicken from the freezer, but is noticed by Michael Myers. Gina forgets to close the shed door and turn off the light, so Michael is able to collect a hammer from the shed before following Gina into the house. While she waits for the chicken to defrost, Gina makes herself a ham sandwich; after sitting down to eat her sandwich, Michael enters the kitchen. As Gina gasps in terror, Michael uses the hammer to bludgeon her to death. Michael stole the knife she was using to cut ham, and used it as his main weapon for most of his other killings in Haddonfield.
